cases.source_title: SWAP: a Guide to Overwatch 2 Counters

call.how: Stay on Zarya on Lijiang Tower Control Center.

cases.reason: Two soft counters are not enough to swap when the map is small and good for Zarya and bad for those DPS. His rule of 3.5: hard counter 2, bad map 1.5, soft counter 1; consider swapping at 3.5 or more.
cases.notes: Worked example in a counter guide, not a live match.

call.how: The swap to D.Mon is fine, but the real fix is retaking map control (move left or main).

cases.reason: He likes D.Va into Cass, Junk and Hog, but D.Mon is good on this flat map that needs no verticality; the swap does not fix the map-control problem.
cases.notes: 6v6 match; my_team lists only the heroes the player named at 57:00.

cases.source_title: This Tank Refused To Counter Swap... Was It The Right Choice? - Overwatch 2 Spectating

call.how: Stay on Ramattra; ignore teammates asking for Zarya or Reinhardt, and pressure the backline.

cases.reason: D.Va cannot Defense Matrix Ramattra's damage, and the real problem was target priority, not the hero.
cases.notes: The enemy also ran Hazard earlier in the match.

cases.source_title: This Is Why You're Losing on Tank | Overwatch 2 VOD REVIEW (Rialto)

call.how: Do not swap to Roadhog here; play behind the cart and save hooks for later in the map.

cases.reason: First point on Rialto is a poor Hog map, and Orisa plus a damage-boosted Bastion make it hard to get close; Orisa, Ana and Mauga are big Hog counters.
cases.notes: The player did swap to Roadhog; the coach disagrees with it (13:40 and 21:26).
